subject: Re: MAP request — compliance gates, DPA and data retention
messages:
From: Ava Morales <ava.morales@montecalvo.com>
To: rohan_mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Julian Park <julian.park@montecalvo.com>, procurement@montecalvo.com
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP request — compliance checkpoints and timing

Hi Rohan,

Thanks for the demo last week. MonteCalvo legal and procurement have asked that we put together a mutual action plan (MAP) focused specifically on compliance gates before we pull the PO trigger. High level asks from our side:

- SOC 2: copy of latest report and targeted controls for production telemetry and incident response.
- SIG/CAIQ: completed spreadsheet covering our primary controls matrix (auth, encryption, data locality).
- DPA: a draft we can redline; key items: data retention, subprocessors, and KMS key control.
- Data retention expectations: we need to understand default retention for logs, user data, and ephemeral caches.

Can you share a 2–3 week MAP with milestones (POC evidence, security review, final DPA) and the expected acceptance criteria for each gate? Procurement has a target decision window ending the week of Dec 13.

Thanks —
Ava Morales
Head of Platform Integrations
MonteCalvo Financial

From: rohan_mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Ava Morales <ava.morales@montecalvo.com>
Cc: Julian Park <julian.park@montecalvo.com>, procurement@montecalvo.com
Date: 2026-11-23T10:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP request — compliance checkpoints and timing

Hi Ava —

Appreciate the clear list. I put together a concise MAP draft and attached the initial artifacts (SIG spreadsheet, DPA draft, and a SOC2 breakdown that maps our controls to your asks). High-level MAP milestones (proposed):

1) Week 0 (Nov 23–27): Share artifacts + kickoff call (security + procurement).
   - Deliverables: MonteCalvo_SIG_SAAS.xlsx, DPA_draft_MC_v2.docx, SOC2_breakdown.pdf
   - Acceptance: artifacts received and kickoff scheduled.

2) Week 1 (Nov 30–Dec 4): Evidence sprint / technical POC for production telemetry and encryption.
   - Deliverables: short evidence packets (KMS config notes, network ACLs, sample audit logs), 2-hour technical session.
   - Acceptance: security team confirms evidence scope met or opens <=3 findings.

3) Week 2 (Dec 7–Dec 11): Legal diligence / DPA redlines and final SIG clarifications.
   - Deliverables: redlined DPA, final SIG spreadsheet, SOC2 controls mapping.
   - Acceptance: procurement confirms legal OK or provides final list of redlines; target for DocuSign-ready DPA.

4) Decision window (Dec 13–17): Procurement finalizes PO/contract.

Retention positions (initial):
- Audit logs (security events, telemetry): default 365 days; can extend for enterprise contracts.
- User-generated content (customer data): default retention 90 days after account deletion unless otherwise contracted.
- Ephemeral/cache (KV/prefix caches): retained up to 30 days; typical PII not stored.

If that looks acceptable, I’ll schedule the kickoff with your security and procurement teams and loop in our CS engineer for the evidence sprint.

Attachments: MonteCalvo_SIG_SAAS.xlsx, DPA_draft_MC_v2.docx, SOC2_breakdown.pdf

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0149

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: rohan_mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: MonteCalvo MAP — retention and evidence notes

Rohan / Lauren —

Thanks for the draft. A few recommended clarifications before kickoff (so we don’t get pushed on acceptance criteria):

- Keep audit logs at 365 days as you proposed. For SOC2 evidence we should surface the relevant control IDs and a sanitized sample rather than raw logs.
- For user data retention, propose 90 days as standard but include an optional enterprise clause for 1+ year on request (we can list this as a procurement add-on).
- DPA: we should pre-approve the vendor/processors list but mark subprocessors as "notified" with 30-day notice; legal may push back, so leave flexibility.
- SIG spreadsheet: add a column for "evidence artifact" with links to the expected doc names (SOC2_breakdown.pdf, KMS_config_notes.md).

I can draft the kickoff slide and evidence checklist. Want to recommend a short template acceptance statement for each gate: e.g., "Security accepts conditional closure pending <=3 findings; legal accepts DPA redline or issues final list".

Would you like me on the kickoff call? I can handle the evidence walk-through.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, rohan_mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: MonteCalvo MAP — retention and evidence notes

Agree with Neha. Two quick additions:

- DPA: pre-fill standard Redwood positions: audit logs 365d, user data default 90d, ability to contractually extend. KMS: we offer either Redwood-managed keys or customer-managed keys (bring your own KMS) for dedicated/private deployments — note both options in the DPA appendix.
- Offer a one-week extension on the procurement decision if they need a finalize pass on redlines; gives legal breathing room and avoids a rushed signature.

Neha — yes please join kickoff and lead the evidence walkthrough. Rohan — schedule the kickoff with all stakeholders and include procurement contact.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

From: Ava Morales <ava.morales@montecalvo.com>
To: rohan_mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Julian Park <julian.park@montecalvo.com>, procurement@montecalvo.com
Date: 2026-11-30T11:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP request — compliance checkpoints and timing

Thanks Rohan — the MAP looks good as a starting point. A few follow-ups from legal/procurement:

- Can you upload the SOC2 breakdown and SIG spreadsheet to a shared folder (we prefer Google Drive links)?
- Procurement wants the DPA redline returned by Dec 10; they will aim to issue an internal go/no-go by Dec 13.
- For retention: legal flagged the 90-day user data window as a potential blocker; they asked whether we can provide an enterprise option that defaults to 1 year for specific data classes. Is that something Redwood supports?

Procurement contact: procurement@montecalvo.com (cc’d).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — please confirm the kickoff time next week.

Best,
Ava

From: rohan_mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Ava Morales <ava.morales@montecalvo.com>
Cc: Julian Park <julian.park@montecalvo.com>, procurement@montecalvo.com, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T16:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP request — compliance checkpoints and timing

Ava —

Thanks — confirmed. I uploaded the artifacts to a shared folder and started the DocuSign envelope for DPA_draft_MC_v2. Links below:
- Evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bMC-evidence
- DocuSign (DPA v2): https://redwood.example.com/docusign/MC-DPA-v2

On retention: we will propose the following position in the DPA appendix:
- Audit logs: 365 days (default).
- User-generated content: 90 days by default; enterprise option to extend to 1 year for specified data classes (requires amendment at contracting).
- Ephemeral/cache: up to 30 days; not used for PII storage.

Neha will lead the evidence walkthrough in kickoff (I put her on the calendar invite for Nov 30 at 10:00 PT). If procurement needs more time, we’re prepared to extend the decision window to Dec 20.

Next steps:
1) Security kickoff + evidence walkthrough (Nov 30 10:00 PT).
2) Procurement to return DPA redlines by Dec 10.
3) Formal decision week Dec 13–20 (buffer in place).

If that works, I’ll mark the MAP status as "in progress" on the deal record and update the close plan.

Thanks —
Rohan Mehta
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0149
